newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Toyota Argentina gets $75 mln loan from Japan.
newsitem.headline: Toyota Argentina gets $75 mln loan from Japan.

text.p: Japanese carmaker Toyota Motor Co's Argentine unit announced Friday it signed a $75 million loan from the Eximbank of Japan through Argentina's state-run Banco Nacion.
Toyota Argentina's head of Institutional Relations Raul Gatica told Reuters $50 million of the $75 million loan would be used in the $150 million plant the company opened in March.
Banco Nacion will act as the administrator of the loan the Eximbank granted as part of its program to enhance Japanese investments abroad.
The remaining $25 million will be used to purchase staff training equipment, Gatica said.
Toyota's plant in Zarate, 50 miles (80 km) north of Buenos Aires, will produce 10,000 units of the 4x4 and 4x2 single- and double-cabin Hiluxes in 1997. Production is scheduled to double next year.
The plant employs 500 workers and the payroll is expected to increase to 850 at a later stage.
